properties.site-address: Land rear of Olinda (wider), Ash Road, Hartley
properties.notes: The site comprises two parcels of land south of Hartley at the edge of the settlement. One contains a residential dwelling, outbuilding, garden and scrubland to the rear. The other comprises a rectangular parcel of overgrown scrubland. Bounded by Ash Road to the east, residential development to the north, and open countryside to the west and south.
